records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Quick note to see how things are going. A lot of teams get stuck at the same step -- inviting teammates -- so if that's where you are, happy to walk through it.

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Blue Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Your workspace for Blue Dynamics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:0b1d3d75, email:e1489b83, email:2c3ddfe4), no tickets, and no project or invite. Total silence plus all three stall reasons suggests low unaided odds of hitting the milestone in the remaining 8 days, though the Pro plan implies some intent.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Blue Dynamics project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

I know a new tool can be easy to put off in a busy week, so I won't pile on. One thing worth knowing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is what makes the rest useful. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you're ready for that.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you — just reply with a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
